rooms.name: Universal washroom
rooms.src: NBC 3.8.3.12 via the Ontario mirror text (obc-342.pages.dev b-3.8.3.12; trust 70, code, mirror text): no internal dimension under 1,700 mm, 1,700 mm turning circle, 810 × 1,830 mm adult change-table space. VBBL 2025 numbers it 3.8.3.13 (vbbl25_3831x, the project's PDF, trust 90): 1,700 mm turning space (1)(j); no "no internal dimension under 1,700 mm" clause; the change table (810 × 1,830 mm, plus a 900 × 1,350 mm transfer space beside it) only where 3.8.2.8.(15) asks for it (A, B-2 or E occupant load over 500). 5.4 m² = 1.7 × 3.2 m (cascade 15c reading; the code gives no area) — step 1, hard. pass 3; (project decision, 15 Nov 18:40)

rooms.name: Universal shower
rooms.checkInDesign: door swing and turning if the shower is its own room (project decision, 15 Nov 18:55)
rooms.src: shower at least 1,500 mm wide × 900 mm deep, with a clear floor at its entrance at least 900 mm deep and as wide as the shower: VBBL 2025 3.8.3.17.(1)(a)-(b) (vbbl25_3831x, the project's PDF, trust 90); room 1.5 × 1.8 = 2.7 m², minW 1.5 m (the shower's width). The universal washroom's 1.7 m dimension doesn't apply (project decision, 15 Nov 18:55; was 4.4 m² under). Halifax barrier-free washroom sheet, NBC 2015 / NS 2022 (trust 60). 1 per 20: typ_shelter_laundry_torTSS2026ch9 9.3.2(a)(v) — step 1, hard.

rooms.name: Laundry with clean-linen storage: washers, heat-pump dryers, folding
rooms.occ: A-2 (part of the shelter, our reading)
rooms.src: count: typ_shelter_laundry_usaceLaundry (1:25), typ_shelter_laundry_cfr654412 (1:50) — step 4 (machine count kept; the floor is now the per-guest rule); size: 0.9–1.4 m² a guest: 8 lb a guest-day (TRSA hospitality calculator, limited service, trust 60, transferred ?) to 10–13 lb (VA Nursing Home Design Guide, trust 70, high) × 1.2 sq ft per lb a day (I Advance Senior Care, trust 40, care homes); 0.9 the minimum rate, 1.4 the reference; 16 guests = 14.4 / 22.4 m² (our arithmetic). Clean-linen storage inside it: 10 % of the laundry floor (I Advance Senior Care), so no separate linen room.
